title: Simeon's Expedition to Gedor and Seir
description:
In the days of King Hezekiah, Simeonites traveled east toward Gedor to find pasture for their flocks.  
They found rich and good pasture in a wide and peaceful land where descendants of Ham had lived.  
The Simeonites struck down the tents and Meunites who were there, completely destroyed them, and settled in their place.  
Later, five hundred men from the tribe of Simeon, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel – the sons of Jishai – went to Mount Seir.  
They struck down the remaining Amalekites who were still there, and settled on the mountain to this day. [ref:1 Chr 4:39-43|1 Chronicles 4:39-43]
